title: Total Conformal Rigidity in Graphs
summary: We introduce and study a generalization of conformal rigidity for graphs. A graph is $k$-conformally rigid if the uniform edge weights simultaneously maximize the sum of the $k$ smallest nontrivial Laplacian eigenvalues and minimize the sum of the $k$ largest, over all normalized non-negative weight assignments. A graph that is $k$-conformally rigid for every $k$ is called totally conformally rigid.
